title: Construction and initial validation of key gene network for progesterone resistance in endometrial cancer based on genome-wide CRISPR screening
model: Ishikawa endometrial cancer cells, GeCKOv2 library B (3 guides per gene), 10 days DMSO or 15 uM medroxyprogesterone acetate
contrast: MPA vs DMSO, day 10 (1 vs 1, no replicates; screening-level)
paper_method: MAGeCK RRA and MLE (RRA tables in Supplementary Material 5)
paper_calls: RRA p < 0.05: 332 depleted and 3,438 enriched genes (RRA FDR 0.10: 1,228 enriched, 0 depleted); 10 genes picked by intersection with an external expression data set and validated
barcs_calls: 114 genes at FDR 0.10 (105 enriched under MPA, 9 depleted); 123 against the control null; screening-level, no replicate cultures
named_hits: 2/10 at FDR 0.10 (NNMT, ZIC2); all 10 in the paper's direction; SOX17 FDR 0.16
verdict: BARCS and RRA agree on the strongest signal (Spearman 0.52; ATP6V0C, SIN3A, ATP6V1G1, GINS1 at the top), but that signal is mostly essential genes depleted less under slower MPA growth; of the ten validated genes only NNMT and ZIC2 pass FDR 0.10.
